svg.aria-label: agent-keys: how it keeps an AI agent's funds safe
svg.title: agent-keys — how it keeps an AI agent's funds safe

g.text: out of reach of a stolen file

svg.text: Hardware-held keys + an on-chain mandate for autonomous agents
The agent's private key sits on disk
Malware, a leaked backup or a poisoned
dependency can copy it in a second
The key can sign anything, forever
The chip signs. The key never leaves it.
No key file exists — nothing to read or copy
Every action is checked on-chain against
The owner can revoke the agent in one step
Set by the owner. Enforced by the chain, not by the agent.
“No blank checks”: no permits or off-chain signatures for the
account — except x402 payments registered within the budget.
In the chip of the agent's machine
Signs the agent's actions; each one is
Works unattended: no PIN, no touch
A separate device: YubiKey, phone, others*
Sets, rotates and revokes the mandate;
Needs you: PIN and touch, or a biometric
A cold encrypted file, kept off line
Replaces a lost or stolen owner key,
Needs its passphrase · no delay today
The agent's machine never holds the owner key: whoever controls the agent cannot widen its own limits.
sign as the agent once it runs;
not copy the key, not widen its limits
the machine's lock, then the mandate:
nothing without its PIN or biometric;
with it, everything: it is the root
only that lock: a YubiKey blocks after
three wrong PINs; a phone needs you
take root with the recovery key,
if the owner device's lock gives way
the devices' own locks only: the chain
cannot tell a thief from the owner
recover fast: a new owner key,
then a new agent. It is a race
With both devices gone, only their own locks and the speed of the recovery stand between a thief and the account. Without a recovery key there is no such move.
Linux TPM, Secure Enclave and TROPIC01
keys signed live on Base Sepolia
YubiKey: root of a Base Sepolia account
* Hardware the project's code has been run with so far. The list grows as more devices are tested; status of each: docs/FAQ.md
